subject.title: feat: add account feed model API

question: Should the account/publisher feed API require legacy personal-publisher compatibility before public contract review, or is an ownerPublisherId-only first slice acceptable?
rationale: The PR creates a new public API/schema surface while ClawHub still preserves dual publisher ownership paths, so automation cannot choose the long-term compatibility boundary for maintainers.

options.title: Require compatibility first
options.body: Require the PR to reuse existing personal-publisher fallback paths, add linkedUserId and ownerUserId regression coverage, and provide live route proof before accepting the public contract.

options.title: Accept narrower first slice
options.body: Maintainers may intentionally ship ownerPublisherId-only feeds, but should document that legacy personal content can be absent from this first API slice.

options.title: Pause for feed-stack alignment
options.body: Keep the draft paused until the account feed, registry bridge, and related discovery contract work are ordered or split.

recommendation.title: Require compatibility first
recommendation.body: Require the PR to reuse existing personal-publisher fallback paths, add linkedUserId and ownerUserId regression coverage, and provide live route proof before accepting the public contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick has the strongest current-history connection to the publisher compatibility helpers and public feed route patterns this PR depends on.
